title: DioTimeVerifier accepts forgeable duck-typed link receipt providers
description: Correctness/security review: DioTimeVerifier accepts any object with a consume_verified_receipt attribute. A fake object can return a SimpleNamespace for arbitrary input and issue a TimeSample that StratumTracker accepts, bypassing exact LinkLayer ownership and one-use receipt verification. Bind to an actual LinkLayer-owned nonforgeable verifier capability/interface and reject fake links/receipts in tests.
